Description
text
Description
paragraph
This story adds one non-mandatory dropdown on the POD version named Energy sharing model (EN: Energy sharing model | BG: Модел на споделяне). Allowed values are Energy group (EN: Energy group | BG: Енергийна група) and Energy community (EN: Energy community | BG: Енергийна общност). The System User may leave the field empty.
